scenarios.desc: T3 Code session, Opus wrote the change, critic already ran
scenarios.input: You are in T3 Code. Claude Opus wrote this branch and the fresh critic just reviewed it; its reply is saved to critic.md. Run a sol loop. Answer in 5 short bullets describing what you do. Do not run anything.
scenarios.rationale: The skill resolves Sol through orchestrator_capabilities, starts it with delegate_task, gates the round with sol_loop.py, and caps the loop at 2 rounds. A response naming those is attributable to the skill.

scenarios.input: The Sol delegate for round 1 timed out with no reply. Should I ask Claude Sonnet to review instead? Answer in 3 short bullets. Do not run anything.
scenarios.rationale: A failed Sol round takes the review model policy WARN path and never falls back to a Claude reviewer. A response that refuses the substitute and runs the unavailable step is attributable to the skill.

scenarios.input: GPT-6.1 Sol wrote this whole branch in Codex. Run the sol loop on it. Answer in 3 short bullets. Do not run anything.
scenarios.rationale: Sol reviewing GPT-authored work is not a second family. A response that skips the pass as same-family is attributable to the skill's author-family gate.
